programme.desc: S3 E9 — O Rastro do Assassino Três mulheres morrem da mesma doença misteriosa e a polícia inicia uma investigação para provar que suas mortes não foram por acaso. Os detetives não sabem que estão sendo enganados pelo assassino, que passou despercebido.
programme.title: Diabólicos - A Face Oculta do Amor

programme.desc: S1 E5 — Medo do Homem Éter Um estuprador em série conhecido como Homem do Éter espreita mulheres em Albuquerque, Novo México. As vítimas não conseguem identificar o agressor mascarado, que começa a expandir seu campo de ação.
programme.title: Segredos Bem Casados

programme.desc: S1 E8 — O Planejador Investigadores de Los Angeles tentam capturar um ladrão de iates sofisticados, mas descobrem que ele está envolvido em crimes muito mais graves.
programme.title: Segredos Bem Casados

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Sim, Senhor Uma jovem desaparece em Dublim, na Irlanda, e a família acredita que ela se suicidou após a morte da mãe. Eles nunca desconfiaram de que ela morreu durante uma sessão de práticas sadomasoquistas.
programme.title: Segredos Bem Casados

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Palavra de Morte A Igreja Palavra de Vida começou como um grupo de estudos bíblicos conduzido pelo pastor Jerry Irwin. Sua filha, Tiffanie, assume o controle após a morte do pai, o que leva à morte brutal de um adolescente.
programme.title: People Magazine: Por Dentro das Seitas

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Os Ministérios de Tony Alamo Criada por Susan e Tony Alamo, a Fundação Cristã Alamo ajudava jovens a buscar um propósito. Depois da morte de Susan, Tony revela um lado sombrio, persegue seus seguidores e seduz várias fiéis adolescentes.
programme.title: People Magazine: Por Dentro das Seitas

programme.desc: S1 E2 — O Massacre de Jonestown No fim da década de 1950, Jim Jones funda o Templo dos Povos para ajudar os necessitados. Em 1975, ele cria a utópica comunidade de Jonestown, que se torna o cenário do maior suicídio coletivo da história.
programme.title: People Magazine: Por Dentro das Seitas

programme.desc: S2 E14 — Invasões e Discussões O COPOM lida com uma invasão a uma residência. O GATE é acionado. Enquanto isso, uma tentativa de roubo a uma casa deixa uma família traumatizada. E uma briga conjugal leva um homem trancado em uma laje a pedir a ajuda do COPOM.
programme.title: Olhos da Lei

programme.desc: S2 E15 — Resgate, Ameaças e Perseguição O GATE é acionado para conter um homem transtornado que ameaça familiares com um facão enquanto o COPOM apoia uma perseguição. Equipes do COBOM e do helicóptero Águia atuam em um acidente com vítimas atropeladas.
programme.title: Olhos da Lei

programme.desc: S3 E3 — Terror na Rua Câmeras captam um chocante atropelamento de uma mulher que curtia uma festa, com fuga do motorista; um homem rouba a bolsa de uma avó da mesa de um restaurante, mas ela parte em perseguição ao ladrão no estacionamento.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S3 E1 — Irresponsável ao Volante Como em uma cena de filme, a polícia persegue pelas ruas um ladrão que dirige um trailer roubado. Outra perseguição perigosa tem uma reviravolta chocante quando a polícia percebe que a motorista leva seu bebê no banco de trás.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S3 E8 — Onde Ele Está se Escondendo Uma parada de trânsito ameaça se tornar mortal para um policial quando uma mãe recorre a medidas extremas para proteger seu filho; uma noite tranquila em casa se transforma em terror.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S2 E8 — Estamos Te Vendo Cansada de lidar com o caos gerado pelo casal conhecido como vizinhos do inferno, uma mulher resolve filmá-los, e tem início uma explosão; um casal distraído namorando nem percebe que o bar está sendo assaltado à mão armada.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S1 E5 — Quase Chegando; Cortina de Fumaça Um tiroteio se torna mortal no Mississippi e os investigadores analisam câmeras para identificar os suspeitos; em Utah, o caso de pessoa desaparecida se torna uma investigação de assassinato.
programme.title: Crime em Tempo Real

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Ponto Cego A polícia de Jacksonville, Flórida, encontra o corpo de Sami Safar, mas ainda não imagina a magnitude do crime organizado que está por trás. O assassinato do trabalhador imigrante sírio revela uma rede de roubos e crimes que se estende por anos.
programme.title: Policial Bom, Policial Mau

programme.desc: S3 E5 — Invasores Um invasor indecente ronda o pátio dos fundos de uma residência; um intruso invade uma casa aleatória e age como se fosse o proprietário do imóvel; um invasor reincidente aterroriza um bairro tranquilo.
programme.title: Pelados e Condenados

programme.desc: S2 E3 — Pelados e Destemidos Um homem sem pudor comete uma agressão em uma estrada; em um dia ensolarado na Filadélfia, pessoas se surpreendem com uma exibição inesperada; um museu é invadido por uma pessoa completamente nua.
programme.title: Pelados e Condenados

programme.desc: S9 E8 — Desaparecimento Mortal No Oregon, um suspeito de assassinato foge do tribunal. Em Wisconsin, um ladrão de carros ataca um cliente de uma loja de departamentos antes de fugir, iniciando uma perseguição que se estende por três condados.
programme.title: Bodycam - Registros Criminosos

programme.desc: S2 E2 — A Raiva Adora Companhia Uma mulher morde um motorista depois de discutir sobre uma porta amassada; uma jovem faz manobras evasivas para escapar de um motorista enfurecido; uma mulher foge de um motorista descontrolado.
programme.title: Fúria no Trânsito

programme.desc: S3 E3 — Legítima Defesa Motoristas enfrentam um homem enfurecido em um posto de gasolina. Bons samaritanos resgatam vítimas de discussões violentas no trânsito. Um homem defende seu filho de uma ameaça armada.
programme.title: Fúria no Trânsito

programme.desc: S1 E8 — Família Ameaçada Uma professora de dança recebe uma mensagem do ex-marido, que apontando uma arma para a própria cabeça. Ele afirma que está a caminho do estúdio de dança e ameaça matar toda a família. A polícia precisa convencê-lo a se entregar.
programme.title: Na Mira dos Sequestradores

programme.desc: S3 E8 — Distúrbio Doméstico Com uma casa nova e um noivo que a ama, Lisa Filiaggi acredita que finalmente a sorte está a seu lado. Mas os problemas do passado voltam para assombrá-la e ameaçam destruir seu futuro.
programme.title: Seu Pior Pesadelo

programme.desc: S2 E2 — Nem Tudo É o que Parece O misterioso desaparecimento de um morador abala a pequena cidade de Eastman, na Geórgia. As buscas por Russell Ray são intensas, até a polícia fazer uma descoberta terrível e localizar um suspeito improvável.
programme.title: Mentiras Criminosas

programme.desc: S6 E3 — O Álibi Durante um assalto à mão armada, um homem é morto a tiros. Vinte e três anos depois do crime, a família do condenado insiste em sua inocência.
programme.title: People Magazine - Além da Notícia

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Onde Está Tom Brown Teorias de conspiração abalam uma pequena cidade do Texas depois que um jogador de futebol americano colegial desaparece misteriosamente. Pistas chocantes e a pressão da comunidade levam a suspeitos incomuns.
programme.title: Assassinato de uma Sexta à Noite

programme.desc: S3 E6 — Quem os Queria Mortos? Um soldado sobrevive à guerra em dois países para encontrar seu fim em Nova York, e seus colegas militares são suspeitos; um jovem aspirante a político desaparece e a principal pista é uma mensagem de voz apavorante.
programme.title: Ainda um Mistério

programme.desc: S9 E9 — Um Tiro no Escuro Ida Mae Ford é morta a tiros em uma rua escura perto de sua casa em Macon, Geórgia. Durante a investigação do caso, uma onda de crimes chocante leva a polícia a um suspeito inesperado.
programme.title: Câmera Crime

programme.desc: S6 E1 — Algo que um Homem Faria Uma mulher encontra o irmão mais velho com a garganta cortada em seu quarto. Descobrir a verdade é um desafio para os investigadores, já que o assassino é um psicopata manipulador que tenta enganá-los.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S6 E3 — Pérolas aos Porcos A polícia procura um homem desaparecido em uma fazenda e encontra ossos de uma perna humana. A proprietária, Susan Monica, faz uma confissão estarrecedora: seus porcos devoraram seu inquilino - e ele não é a única vítima.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S6 E2 — Eu Sou um Assassino em Série! Um serial killer que está no corredor da morte - cujos alvos eram o líder dos direitos civis Vernon Jordan e o editor Larry Flynt - confessa outros assassinatos não solucionados graças a uma astuta promotora.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S3 E2 — Os Monstros do Quarteirão Por anos, moradores de um subúrbio de Indianápolis eram cautelosos com a família Reese, mas ninguém imaginava o horror que ocorria atrás da porta até a família virar suspeita de um assassinato brutal.
programme.title: DNA Criminoso

programme.desc: S3 E4 — Estrada Para o Inferno Quando uma jovem de Utah foi sequestrada e morta, ninguém imaginou que seria o começo de uma onda de homicídios, provocada por uma família que viajou por dois anos deixando um rastro de corpos.
programme.title: DNA Criminoso

programme.desc: S14 E1 — Que Bom que a Mamãe Morreu Victoria e Christine Lisowski morrem de medo da mãe, Sungnam Kwon-Lisowski. Elas nem imaginam que no Natal terão sorte de sobreviver ao feriado e à vingança maluca de sua mãe.
programme.title: Vivendo com o Inimigo

programme.desc: S14 E8 — Três Horas e Meia no Inferno Sara Pitcher acredita que Shawn Spink é um homem de Deus, sem saber que logo enfrentará três horas e meia de puro terror. A polícia acredita que a sobrevivência de Sara é um milagre, mas sua vida nunca mais será a mesma.
programme.title: Vivendo com o Inimigo

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Pecados do Pai Em Rockville, Maryland, em 1993 uma mulher descobre que sua irmã e seu sobrinho foram assassinados a sangue-frio; uma mulher se envolve em uma conspiração de homicídio; um promotor faz da condenação de um assassino sua missão.
programme.title: Vidas Destruídas

programme.desc: S3 E1 — As Sombras de South Hill Em outubro de 1980, uma mulher se torna vítima do famoso estuprador de South Hill. Enquanto um investigador segue os passos do agressor, um homem não desconfia que o suspeito que todos procuram está bem diante de seu nariz.
programme.title: Vidas Destruídas

programme.desc: S1 E5 — Laços de Sangue Ray Kotomski, um agente penitenciário aposentado, acredita que a fase negra de sua vida ficou para trás. Mas lidar com a segunda esposa e sua família hostil se transforma em uma tarefa fatal.
programme.title: Emboscada

programme.desc: S1 E7 — Vítima do Ciúme A lenda do esporte Morris Blankenbaker vive feliz com sua família até se envolver em um triângulo amoroso com o melhor amigo e sua esposa. Ciúmes e violência levam à morte de Morris.
programme.title: Emboscada

programme.desc: S3 E10 — As Irmãs Diabólicas Samuel Johnson Jr. desaparece de repente e os investigadores de San Antonio conversam com duas irmãs que sabem de alguma coisa. Uma série de interrogatórios revela o plano meticuloso de uma mente controladora.
programme.title: Diabólicos - A Face Oculta do Amor

programme.desc: S3 E6 — Me Ensine a Matar Em Las Vegas, um pai de quatro filhos é encontrado morto em seu carro, após ser amarrado, amordaçado e asfixiado. Testemunhas apontam um homem chamado John Brian Ray. Mas ele é apenas uma peça no jogo de um gênio do crime.
programme.title: Diabólicos - A Face Oculta do Amor

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Estrelas Mirins Violentas No auge dos programas para a família dos anos 1990, atores mirins eram o centro das atenções. Para alguns, a transição para a rotina depois da fama se torna insuportável, gerando consequências trágicas.
programme.title: O Lado Sombrio de Hollywood

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Luxo e Tragédia Pela primeira vez, uma ex-colega conta como uma dona de casa construiu seu império multimilionário com base em mentiras. Taylor Armstrong lança nova luz sobre o suposto abuso de seu marido e os rumores perturbadores que ainda cercam sua morte.
programme.title: O Lado Sombrio de Hollywood

programme.desc: S3 E4 — O Doutor e a Coelhinha Jackie Hendrickson está proibida de confraternizar com os clientes. Mas o cirurgião plástico de Atlanta, Dr. Warren Brown, é irresistível.
programme.title: Playboy - Fama e Morte

programme.desc: S3 E3 — A Coelhinha e o Serial Killer Kerissa Fare comemora sua edição como capa da revista, até que um homem misterioso de seu passado é ligado a assassinatos e vira alvo da polícia.
programme.title: Playboy - Fama e Morte

programme.desc: S2 E16 — Ameaças, Intervenção e Aniversário O GATE é acionado para negociar com um homem armado que não quer se entregar; o COPOM ajuda policiais que intervém em um assalto. E uma chamada inusitada leva patrulhas a surpreenderem uma criança em sua festa de aniversário.
programme.title: Olhos da Lei

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Chamados do 190 Veja que o Copom, Centro de Operações da Polícia Militar de SP, atende a mais de 30 mil chamados. Um deles chegou até o GATE.
programme.title: Olhos da Lei

programme.desc: S2 E9 — Criminosos Enlouquecidos Acusada de furto em uma loja, uma mulher se descontrola completamente ao ser confrontada por um funcionário; a câmera de uma rodovia capta a aterrorizante cena de um motorista irresponsável batendo em placas e em outros carros.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S3 E10 — Ataques Surpresa Uma briga de trânsito foge do controle quando um homem resolve perseguir e ameaçar um casal que o cortou acidentalmente; um encontro amigável no posto de gasolina se torna assustador.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Faça o Bem Um homem vê uma mulher sendo arrastada na rua; um rapaz visita a namorada no trabalho, no Dia dos Namorados, quando um ladrão sobe no balcão; heróis vão entrar em ação e salvar o dia.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Raptadas Uma jovem volta para casa depois de um encontro de família. Outra jovem sai para comprar remédio. Do nada, o perigo ataca e ambas são sequestradas. Mas as duas corajosas mulheres levam a melhor sobre os criminosos.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: It has all come down to the final night of training camp. Tonight, dreams will be made or broken.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: In this two-hour season premiere of Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team, 600 hopeful candidates arrive at Cowboys Stadium for the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders preliminary auditions.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Training Camp opens and many of the new candidates have had to uproot their lives and move to Dallas with no guarantee of making it through Training Camp to become a Dallas Cowboy Cheerleader.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: It is just the second week of rehearsals and Kelli and Judy are quick to run the Training Camp Candidates through the signature kick line and jump split.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: In week three of training camp, the rookie candidates are brought in for their DCC makeover. Under the scrutiny of Kelli Finglass, new hairstyles and makeup applications give the girls the DCC look.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: It's week five of training camp and Kelli is out sick. DCC Technical Director, Kitty Carter, fills in and runs the first rehearsal of the week.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Week 7 of training camp begins with a rehearsal on the field at Cowboys Stadium. Kelli and Judy are ready to make final cuts and tonight's rehearsal could determine who makes the squad.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: It's time to announce the DCC squad but first Kelli and Judy put the candidates through a final field rehearsal at Cowboys Stadium. Tensions run high among the girls as Kelli and Judy watch their every step.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: The squad has their first game day performance behind them, but after a bad rehearsal, Kelli warns her new team she will cut girls if they don't give 110 percent.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: The Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders take a break from the sidelines and travel to Mexico for their annual swimsuit calendar photo shoot.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: The Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders are in full dance mode preparing for their first regular-season home game performance. Kelli and Judy want the choreography to be perfect and press the girls through a few intense rehearsals.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: In the final episode of the series, the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders are preparing for their marquee performance - The Susan G. Komen Cancer Awareness Halftime Show during a nationally televised Cowboys football game.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Dreams are on the line as the tryouts for the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders 2013-2014 squad begin.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: The pressure is mounting as 54 new candidates compete with 32 returning veterans for an invitation into the famed Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders training camp.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Training camp begins at the Cowboys famous training facility, Valley Ranch. First Meeting is filled with excitement and energy until Kelli calls a special meeting of the veterans.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: The "scariest night of training camp" kicks off this dramatic episode as the girls learn the dreaded jumpsplit! It's mind over body, as the girls attempt this famed and required move.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: The ladies are really challenged when guest choreographer DJ Guthrie teaches them a new dance style. Kelli and Judy have some tough decisions to make about who will remain on the squad.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: The training camp candidates hold their breath as the one and only Kitty Carter pays a visit to training camp. Kitty takes no prisoners as she rips into the new girls as well as the vets.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: With their futures on the line, the training camp candidates try to push through their heightened emotions to show Kelli and Judy they deserve to be part of America's Sweethearts. Unfortunately, for some "Tonight will be your last night".

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: This is it, the last chance, as the girls finally learn their fate. Dreams start coming true as the girls pose for Squad Photo. There is some great dancing as Show Group and the rest of the squad perform for the first time at a new "Meet The Team" event.

programme.desc: When Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) is informed that a death row prisoner wants him present at his execution, the chief struggles over whether capital punishment is cruel and unusual punishment or an appropriate sentence for the crime he committed.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women who kill husbands, lovers, rivals and parents will shock society. But a very special horror is reserved for women who will kill their own.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Sometimes, when a man and a woman unite, a terrible urge for destruction can awaken in them both. Happy couples become deadly teams, intent on one goal: murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women are more often prey than predators, but the exceptions are deadly women indeed. In this episode, we’ll discover what drove these deadly women to prey on the unsuspecting.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While their sisters chose a life of sensible, suburban motherhood, these deadly women chose a life of crime. They lived with the thrills, the danger and the deadly consequences of being outlaws.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Married to Murder
programme.desc: To the outside world, their marriages seemed happy. But behind closed doors, there was no domestic bliss. These women wanted out, but getting a divorce wasn’t their preferred option.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: No one doubts a woman’s capacity to love, but sometimes lust can turn lethal. In the ultimate fatal attraction, "Deadly Women" looks at cases of murder driven by obsessive love.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Judi Buenoano secretly murdered lovers to claim on insurance policies whilst nurse Genene Jones secretly killed at least 46 infants left in her care between 1980 and 1982.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women never get their hands dirty: no blood touched them because they manipulate others to kill for them...but they didn't get away.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Under His Control
programme.desc: These are love stories with bleak, bloody endings. Blinded by desire, obsessed and malleable, some women fall into lethal relationships with dangerous, controlling men.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Sins of the Sister
programme.desc: A sisterly bond can mean a life full of friendship and sibling love. But for some women, having a sister means nothing more then having their own personal meal ticket, scapegoat and combatant. These types of relationships can lead to deadly outcomes.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Kill For Cash
programme.desc: Money is a strong motivator. It can be used for good. It can be used for evil. It can be the driving force behind murder. These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Deadly Delinquents
programme.desc: In the tormented mind of a young school girl, jealousy can turn to a murderous rage. These deadly girls turn on their own and kill their friends. This is the brutal world of deadly delinquents.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Killer Kids
programme.desc: For many parents, their children's teen years can be one big headache. But when typical teenage rebellion turns into deadly rage, a parent's love may not be enough to save their life.

programme.desc: Anger, fear and despair are basic human emotions. But when these emotions are coupled with a broken mind, a perfect storm is created. Teetering on the edge of unbalance, these women resort to murder when pushed to the breaking point.

programme.desc: In 2004, Brendan Percy was found dead of hypothermia and dehydration in a sub alpine area above Oamaru in suspicious circumstances.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: A Bump in the Night
programme.desc: In 1980, six-year-old Alicia O'Reilly was raped and murdered in her bed, while her sister slept less than a metre away, and her mother sleeping across the hallway.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Out of Aces
programme.desc: Garth Doull trained to be a policeman but the lure of the race track saw him swap sides of the law to become a consummate con-man. On the 8th of September 1989, his body was found floating in Wellington harbour.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Lost Soul
programme.desc: In 1985, 25-year-old Luana 'La Verne' Williams disappeared from her Tauranga home. Eight years later her disappearance was upgraged to a murder enquiry. Her body has never been found.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Walk of Innocence
programme.desc: In 1970, eighteen-year-old Olive Waiker disappeared as she walked across Rotorua to babysit her nieces and nephews. Her semi-naked body was found hours later in a rest area south of the city..

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Now You See Me
programme.desc: 26-year-old deaf woman Alexa Cullen vanished from her home in Manaia, on the Coromandel Peninsular in 1995. She had a history of hitch-hiking and police suspected she’d run away. But three years later, ominous rumors began circulating in the community.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Sensing Murder Insights - Special
programme.desc: Police detectives from around New Zealand reveal exciting new developments sparked by the Sensing Murder psychics in Series 1.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Girl in The Ditch
programme.desc: When 12 year old Agnes Ali'iva'a drowned in a ditch in 1992, the police initially thought her death was accidental. It was four years before public and political pressure forced police to re-investigate her death.

programme.title: Sensing Murder

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: All My Children
programme.desc: For a guy who started life as a free spirited outlaw-biker Dog has certainly turned into a family man. His children touch everything he does today, from searching for the perfect gift for his daughter Cecily's birthday to hunting a fugitive.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: The hunt for an elusive and clever criminal takes Dog through the world of a bantam fighting cock, a pregnant daughter, and a jungle safe house go together. And don't forget the mopeds as well as a group of hostile squatters on government land!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bounty Baby
programme.desc: What's a father to do? When the cops ask Dog for help tracking down a renegade teen with a history of running hard, Baby Lyssa, eight months pregnant and counting, insists on joining the hunt. Can Dog keep his daughter safe and catch his man?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rain Check
programme.desc: For Dog and Beth it's not only another day in paradise, it's their anniversary. Beth is hoping for a romantic dinner with her man, but she knows only too well that for Dog work always comes first.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Love on the Run
programme.desc: Today Dog finds himself looking for more than one fugitive. He starts the day looking for a woman who has skipped out on her court date. But he soon learns that she has teamed up with a woman whose criminal exploits have attracted the local media.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Jump Start
programme.desc: Dog gave a break to a young man with a drug problem who promised to enter drug rehab. But this commitment to rehabilitation seems to have ended when he bolted from the car on the way to the drug treatment center and went on the run.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Ice Man
programme.desc: Dog's latest fugitive doesn't think small when it comes to illegal drugs: he was carrying almost a pound of meth when he was arrested. Now he's on the run with his pregnant girlfriend on the high plains of Colorado.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Trouble in Paradise
programme.desc: Dog is back in Hawaii and tracking a dangerous fugitive through the jungles of the Big Island. Their prey is being protected by a ring of family and friends that Dog must forcefully confront to bring in his man.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Girl Power
programme.desc: When Dog decides to spend the day caring for his newest granddaughter, Beth enlists the girls to hunt down a female fugitive. Heading into a dangerous part of town the ladies will use their feminine wiles to track this mother gone wrong.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Prodigal Son
programme.desc: Dog and his old friends, Tim Chapman and Sonny Westbrook are riding with the team, so their target, a thief with violent tendencies, is out of luck. When Dog learns that the fugitive is also a disrespectful son, he is more motivated to find his man.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Family Ties
programme.desc: Dog doesn't have the whole team today and he's got to catch a fugitive with a record of criminal assault. But when Dog finds the fugitive's former girlfriend, she thinks he isn't dangerous at all.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Special Delivery
programme.desc: For months, this fugitive has been stringing Leland along with a series of barely believable excuses. Out of patience, Leland calls in the Big Dog. The whole team heads out to put pressure on the family and friends of the fugitive.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Surface Scratches
programme.desc: Dog's latest quarry is running from abuse and assault charges. As Dog investigates, he discovers that this fugitive has gamed the system by jumping from one bond, and one bondsman, to another.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Great Debate
programme.desc: When the co-signer of a bond is also romantically involved with the defendant, sometimes the bondman is put in the middle of a lover's quarrel.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Facebooked
programme.desc: Dog is in Denver helping Bobby Brown to track down a fugitive with a long rap sheet. But unfortunately they have no picture of the felon to work with, so the challenges are big on this one. But Dog discovers a new source; "Facebook".

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mano-a-Mano
programme.desc: Back in Colorado, Dog's on the hunt for a runner with more than a decade's worth of trouble with the law. But the fugitive's friends and family are reluctant to help Dog bring him in.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Road Show: Where Mercy is Shown
programme.desc: After releasing the second part of his autobiography, Dog and his family traveled across America, and this very special episode offers an intimate portrait of both the public and private moments of that journey.
programme.sub-title: The Road Show: Where Mercy is Shown

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Comeback Kid
programme.desc: Dog is back in Colorado chasing a young man with a taste for trouble. He's fled to Texas but with his family's house on the line Dog is willing to try a risky strategy.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Tent City
programme.desc: Today's hunt takes Dog far from the glittering hotels of Waikiki to the parts of Hawaii tourist rarely see, Oahu's ramshackle tent cities. The team searches for a woman who has lost almost everything, her home, her family and her spirit.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Dead of Night
programme.desc: Dog's good friend and fellow bondsman Chris is running out of time. He has only days to find his fugitive or risk losing his business. In his hunt Dog confronts duplicitous tipsters, vicious attack dogs, and hostile neighbors.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Montrose Files: The Million Dollar Man Pt. 1
programme.desc: Dog launches a high stake hunt through the desolate and dangerous mountain landscape of western Colorado in pursuit of a gun-loving survivalist with a million dollar bond on his head. Will Dog's plan of using brains over brawn work?
programme.sub-title: The Montrose Files: The Million Dollar Man Pt. 1

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Montrose Files: The Million Dollar Man Pt. 2
programme.desc: Once in Montrose, Dog discovers that the million dollar fugitive is not the young bondsman's only problem. Dog and Beth make it their mission to both clean up the mess and teach him the fundamentals of bondsmanship.
programme.sub-title: The Montrose Files: The Million Dollar Man Pt. 2

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Montrose Files: Round the Clock
programme.desc: Dog is committed to saving his new friend's bail bonding business, and now must race against time to bring a rogues gallery to justice in the High Sierra mountain town of Montrose, CO.
programme.sub-title: The Montrose Files: Round the Clock

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Montrose Files: And Then There Were None
programme.desc: With four outlaws still on the lam, Dog sets out to bring 'em in. As day turns into night and with the darkness and the danger mounting, an undaunted Dog and team plan late night hits on the riskiest of locations--their targets' homes.
programme.sub-title: The Montrose Files: And Then There Were None

programme.desc: Willie thinks his kids have been spending too much time on their phones and other devices so he initiates a "No-Tech Week," but when he has to participate too it ends up being harder than he thought. There's a lice outbreak at Duck Command.

programme.title: Dynasty: Romance

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.title: Dynasty: The Secret

programme.title: Dynasty: The Letter

programme.title: Dynasty: The Ball

programme.title: Dynasty: Fear
programme.desc: Alexis relinquishes control of Denver-Carrington and the mansion back to Blake; Ben battles Alexis for equal control of Colbyco; Michael Culhane and Alexis form an alliance against Blake.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Rig

programme.title: Dynasty: A Love Remembered, Pt. 1
programme.desc: Ben returns to Blake's aid and pulls him to safety, both narrowly escaping the devastation of the ensuing explosion; Blake suffers memory loss due to the explosion; Alexis leads Blake to believe they have been married for the past twenty-three years.

programme.title: Dynasty: A Love Remembered, Pt. 2
programme.desc: Sammy Jo informs Clay of her desire for an annulment to their marriage; Domique is roughed-up by thugs threatening her to cooperate with their boss, as Gary Tilden coincidentally returns to Denver.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Portrait
programme.desc: Krystle suspects Blake's once passionate feelings for Alexis may still be lingering; Blake and Ben reach a mutual reconciliation; Amanda disappears to London; Leslie Carrington finds Ben.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Birthday
programme.desc: Clay reluctantly signs the annulment papers to end his and Sammy Jo's marriage; Blake persuades leslie Carrington to stay in Denver and Ben a second chance; Adam proposes to Dana.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Test
programme.desc: Krystina lapses into unconsciousness, as doctors fight against time to bring her back; Krystle rebuffs Alexis' sincere concern for Krystina's health; Steven and Sammy Jo assume the appearance of a normal marriage for Danny's sake.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Mothers
programme.desc: Krystina is flown to California, awaiting a donor for her vital heart transplant; Leslie moves in to the Carrington mansion; Blake and Krystle mount a media blitz to plea for a heart donor.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Surgery
programme.desc: Krystina's only hope for life seems dashed, as the mother of the heart donor retracts her offer to allow the operation; Neil McVane carries out his promise of blackmail.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Garage
programme.desc: Krystina is welcomed home, following her so-far successful heart transplant; Alexis' affections are pursued by a wealthy real estate baron; convinced he is not a Carrington, Adam's life begins to crumble.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Shower
programme.desc: Adam continues to slip further away from Dana and his family, as doubts to his Carrington heritage have their effect; Alexis ends her relationship with Michael Culhane.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Dress
programme.desc: Sarah makes a dress for Krystina identical to one worn by her own little girl; concerned over his irrational behavior, Blake hires a private investigator to follow Adam, as his self-destructive quest leads towards disaster.

programme.title: Dynasty: Valez
programme.desc: Steven struggles with his love for Sammy Jo and his homosexuality; despite being warned of Dirk Maurier's questionable business practices, Alexis agrees to a partnership; Leslie and Clay's romance leads to passion.

programme.sub-title: George Scraps His Sculpture/Arthur's Big Meltdown

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur's Tv-Free Week/Night Fright

programme.title: Arthur: Binky Barnes, Art Expert/Arthur's Lucky Pencil

programme.sub-title: Binky Barnes, Art Expert/Arthur's Lucky Pencil

programme.title: Arthur: Muffy's Art Attack/Tales from the Crib
programme.desc: When Muffy sees a kinetic sculptor’s machines, she brags that she can make even better ones. Then, Vicita is upset at having to trade in her cherished crib for a big-girl bed, so D.W. shares her story of that same rite of passage.
programme.sub-title: Muffy's Art Attack/Tales from the Crib

programme.title: Arthur: The Wheel Deal/The Buster Report
programme.desc: After an injury, Brain has to spend some time using a wheelchair. Will he be able to compete in a basketball tournament for charity? The kids are assigned to write a report on someone they admire, and George picks….Buster!

programme.title: Arthur: Unfinished/D.W., Bossy Boots

programme.title: Arthur: The Director's Cut/Crime and Consequences

programme.sub-title: Muffy's Soccer Shocker/Brother, Can You Spare A Clarinet?

programme.sub-title: Castles in the Sky/Tipping the Scales

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: There is a virus spreading through Lakewood Elementary--it’s new nicknames and it’s changing how everyone treats each other! The playground has been quiet lately--too quiet--and the Tough Customers don't like it one bit.
programme.sub-title: Nicked by a Name/The Play's the Thing

programme.title: RAF: The Royal Air Force: Battle for the Skies
programme.desc: The series begins before WWI when military commanders struggled to understand what uses aviation might have. The Wright Brothers had been the first to fly a powered aircraft in controlled flight in 1903, but even by 1914 aircraft were still underpowered.
programme.sub-title: Useless for the Purposes of War

programme.title: RAF: The Royal Air Force: Battle for the Skies
programme.desc: The 1920s and 30s were uncertain times for the RAF as well as all other armed services. With peace came cuts in spending on new aircraft development.

programme.title: RAF: The Royal Air Force: Battle for the Skies
programme.desc: By the end of the war the RAF had aircraft that could escort bombers to targets deep inside Germany and back. With the Gloster Meteor, the RAF had also entered the ‘Jet Age’. Aircraft like the Hawker Hunter and F-86 Sabre took the RAF supersonic.

programme.title: RAF: The Royal Air Force: Battle for the Skies
programme.desc: By the end of the First World War the RAF had bombers that could fly to Berlin and back. For the first time in a thousand years British civilians found themselves under direct attack - by Zeppelin airships and Gotha bombers.

programme.title: RAF: The Royal Air Force: Battle for the Skies
programme.desc: The RAF’s maritime role is often overlooked. Between the wars the RAF operated elegant flying boats to patrol the far flung corners of the Empire.

programme.title: RAF: The Royal Air Force: Battle for the Skies
programme.desc: After the war, RAF transports helped keep Berliners alive during the Soviet blockade of the city in 1948/49. As well as flying round-the-clock operations into the airport, Sunderland flying boats delivered supplies by landing on Lake Havel near the city.

programme.title: RAF: The Royal Air Force: Battle for the Skies
programme.desc: In this programme we bring the RAF story into the modern era. Another aircraft to have extended the RAF’s capabilities is the C130 Hercules. This aircraft has proved its capabilities in countless environments from resupply, to dropping paratroopers.

programme.title: Battle of Britain - Empty Skies
programme.desc: Tells the story of 19 men and women who were there. Through a series of filmed interviews their stories have been preserved, allowing them to tell the part they played in the nation's defence in their own words creating a unique collection of accounts.

programme.title: Allied Commanders of WWII
programme.desc: Heroism was not unique to US commanders, these generals battled the Nazis on all fronts. A look at Bernard Law Montgomery, Georgi Zhukov, and Sir Arthur Harris.

programme.title: Allied Commanders of WWII
programme.desc: The commanders of World War II who led on the high seas and on the homefront. Charles Nimitz, George Marshall, and Joseph Stillwell are seen in profile.

programme.title: Allied Commanders of WWII
programme.desc: From Island-hopping to thirty seconds over Tokyo, this is a look at the battles of Douglas MacArthur, Hap Arnold, and James Doolittle.

programme.title: Anzacs: In The Face Of War
programme.desc: 'ANZACS In the Face of War' presents an historical profile of Australia and new Zealand at the outbreak of war. The legacy of WWI the shared experiences and expectations of WWII.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Inside Man
programme.desc: Chaim Rumkowski, leader of the Lodz ghetto during WWII, believed cooperation with the Nazis could save lives, providing labor in exchange for food. This approach kept some semblance of community and culture alive amidst unimaginable horror.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Belgian Collaborator
programme.desc: Leon Degrelle, a charismatic Belgian leader, joined the Nazis and led Die Wallonien on the Eastern Front. Despite no military background, he earned the Knight's Cross for valor. He recruited 4000 more for the SS, defending Berlin until April 1945.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Croatian Collaborator
programme.desc: Croatia grapples with its fascist past through figures like Dinko Sakic, once hailed as a hero but later convicted of war crimes. Leading the notorious Jasenovac camp, Sakic oversaw brutal atrocities against inmates.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling
programme.desc: Vidkun Quisling, once honored for diplomacy, turned traitor by collaborating with Nazis. His bid for power in Norway failed, relegated by Germans. Despite being named "fuehrer," his reign led to repression until his hanging post-Nazi defeat.

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: In February 2012, a man got into a pick-up truck at a mall close to his home and was never seen alive again. Nine months later, after a huge search was launched, police discovered his human remains.

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: Following the investigation into the death of Nikitta Grender and the extensive forensics that identified her killer.

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: The search for Lori Hacking follows the investigation into her disappearance and how a multitude of forensic techniques revealed her killer.

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: 'Conned to Death' covers the murder of Michele MacNeill and how investigators and forensics brought her killer to justice.

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: December 2000: 19-year-old Rachel Manning was murdered in Milton Keynes. Two men were wrongfully convicted, but new advances in forensics proved that evil always leaves a trace.

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: When the body of a child is found, Boston State Police have no leads, but with the help of the National Centre for Missing and Exploited Children, a trace is found.

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: Edinburgh, October 1977: Christine Eadie and Helen Scott vanish without a trace. The police never stopped hunting for justice, even changing the law to bring the perpetrators to account.

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: Tracie Andrews purportedly witnessed the murder of her boyfriend, Lee Harvey, in a country lane on the night of 1st December 1996; but all was not what it seemed.

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: In late 1992, an attack led to an investigation which would last nearly a quarter of a century. Over time, DNA profiling helped to close a case which detectives feared would never be solved.

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: David Jackson left his home to buy beer and cigarettes. He was never seen again. For 15 years his disappearance remained unsolved, until one investigator broke the case wide open.

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: The murder of Lynette White led to the longest murder trial in British history at the time. Find out how police work and DNA eventually led police to her killer.

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: Rachel O'Reilly was savagely murdered in her home, in what looked like a burglary gone wrong. A ground-breaking investigation finally put her killer behind bars.

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: A popular, healthy, 60-year-old woman suffered a sudden, painful death. Detectives managed to trace the killer, despite their calculated and elaborate web of deceit.

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: A killer, who stalked and gained his victim's trust, enticed her to her death. Almost two decades later scientific advances brought the perpetrator to justice.

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: Covering the 38-year investigation into Jeannie Moore's murder.

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: The story of the senseless murder of Kay Mortensen and the unusual investigation that followed.
programme.sub-title: The Perplexing Case of Kay Mortensen

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: The story of the brutal and senseless murder of Sandra Rozzo. Attempting to understand how and why she died, and how determined police work and forensic science eventually crack the case.

programme.title: Evidence of Evil
programme.desc: Kristen Swanson was murdered in 1980, however the suspect was not found. Eventually, following a 30-year investigation into her death revolutionary DNA techniques allowed the police to track down her killer and bring him to justice.

programme.title: South Park: Chickenpox
programme.desc: Chickenpox: The boys are sent to Kenny's for the night, so they can all get chickenpox. The boys decide to get even on their parents by hiring a prostitute with mouth herpes to infect them. (S2, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Roger Ebert Should Lay Off the Fatty Foods
programme.desc: Roger Ebert Should Lay Off The Fatty Foods: The boys are taken to the planetarium but Cartman has other ideas and decides to audition to sing the Cheesy Poofs song on their next advert. (S2, E11)
programme.sub-title: Roger Ebert Should Lay Off the Fatty Foods

programme.title: South Park: Clubhouses
programme.desc: Clubhouses: Stan and Kyle build a clubhouse, so they can play truth or dare with Wendy and Bebe. Cartman and Kenny decide to build their own rival clubhouse based on The Ewoks Village. (S2, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Cow Days
programme.desc: Cow Days: The boys try to win Terrance and Phillip dolls at the carnival but a dodgy carnie keeps changing the rules - time to call "shenanigans"! Cartman dates Leonardo DiCaprio. (S2, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef Aid: Chef realises that Alanis Morissette's (fictional) hit song "Stinky Britches" is a song that he wrote years ago but the record company aren't interested in giving him any credit. (S2, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Spooky Fish
programme.desc: Spooky Fish: When Stan is given a fish by his Aunt, he has a feeling there's something not quite right about it. Sure enough it's not long before there's evil goings on. (In spooky vision!) (S2, E15)

programme.title: South Park: Merry Christmas Charlie Manson
programme.desc: Merry Christmas, Charlie Manson!: Cartman's Uncle Howard escapes from prison with another inmate, Charlie Manson. The boys want to go see Mr Hankey at the mall but no one will take them. (S2, E16)

programme.title: South Park: Gnomes
programme.desc: Gnomes (a.k.a. Underpants Gnomes): The boys must write an essay for school. Tweek suggests they write about gnomes that visit him every night and steal his pants. What will they discover? (S2, E17)

programme.sub-title: My Adult Brother Is A Loser Living In His Childhood Bedroom

programme.sub-title: Subway Sandwich King To Child Sex Scandal: Jared Fogle Pt.1

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Danny and the guys take on a rare and valuable American street machine with big hopes for bringing it to this year's SEMA Convention in Las Vegas. Meanwhile, Shannon tries to tame a 500 horsepower Boss Hoss motorcycle.

programme.title: JAG: To Walk on Wings
programme.desc: Congresswoman Latham and a colleague watch four marine jumpers jump into the ocean from an M22 Osprey. With two marines left to jump, the plane is struck by a swell in the ocean. Harm and Mac are instructed to investigate.

programme.title: JAG: Guilt
programme.desc: When Captain Huddleston hears that the marine corporal has been charged with rape, he sends Lt. Colonel Sarah Mac MacKenzie to handle the case in a hot zone of Anti-American activity.

programme.title: JAG: Mixed Messages
programme.desc: An intruder shoots three Navy people, killing two. One of the dead is a friend of Harm, who protects his reputation. Webb, counter-espionage, and disinformation are involved; Bud solves it. Mac and Renee return to town; Mac leaves again.

programme.title: JAG: Ambush
programme.desc: Capt. Shepard leads his troop off its peacekeeping mission and into battle with the colonel of the rebel forces. Consequently, six marines die in the public incident. Harm is sent in to investigate despite a recent touch of bad luck in a string of trials.

programme.title: JAG: Jag-a-thon
programme.desc: The JAG gang takes part in a JAGathon, a charity-benefit marathon, which provides opportunities for personal pride and individual competitiveness. Sturgis feels uncertain, and Harm defends a sailor for impersonating an officer.

programme.title: JAG: The Mission
programme.desc: A spotter on the ground calls for an airstrike as he has identified 15 heavily armed suspected Al Qaeda members on horseback. JAG won’t approve the airstrike until the spotter is absolutely certain the men are Al Qaeda members.

programme.title: JAG: Defending His Honor
programme.desc: An ambulance pulls up to a crash site where a woman, Jennifer Wilson, is found injured and crying for her baby. Unbeknownst to her, the six-month-old baby died in the accident. A Navy judge stands accused of vehicular homicide.

programme.title: JAG: In Country
programme.desc: Central Command coordinates an airstrike on a confirmed target traveling through Afghanistan. After the strike is launched, marine troops assess the damage and they are disturbed to learn that they targeted the wrong vehicle and hit civilians instead.

programme.title: JAG: Enemy Below
programme.desc: Kabir is preparing an attack against the U.S. and was last seen crossing the border from Afghanistan to Iran. He is believed to have recruited Capt. Yerastov, a Russian submarine captain. Turner, Harm and Mac help in the hunt for the terrorists.

programme.title: JAG: Critical Condition
programme.desc: Bud has lost his right lower leg due to a mine in Afghanistan; during emergency surgery he faces bad trouble. Sturgis returns to Washington, and Harm and Mac disobey an order from the admiral. Bud encounters an astounding change of course.

programme.title: JAG: Dangerous Game
programme.desc: A deputy sheriff dies while chasing a car carrying two SEALs in a Navy exercise. The driver stands trial for negligent homicide.

programme.title: JAG: In Thin Air
programme.desc: Lt. Albrecht and Lt. Cmdr. Zuzello make Zuzello’s farewell flight before he retires. All is fine until Albrecht notices that his partner is passed out from hypoxia. Albrecht makes an emergency landing on the ship.Harm is sent to the ship to investigate.

programme.title: JAG: Need to Know
programme.desc: As a favor from Congresswoman Lillian Dorning, SECNAV Sheffield asks the JAG staff to get the story of a submarine, USS Angel Shark (SSGN-559), which was lost on a CIA mission in 1968.

programme.title: JAG: Friendly Fire
programme.desc: Harm serves as a judge and Mac is the contentious prosecutor in a case fraught withpolitical implications when an American aviator is charged with killing three Britishsoldiers during a flight mission in Afghanistan.

programme.title: JAG: Shifting Sands
programme.desc: When a Gulf War MIA victim is found as the sheik’s wife in a nomadic Arab tribe, Bud prosecutes and Mac defends her against charges of desertion and, in a stunning turn of events, treason. Harm tries to get his old job back but is turned away.

programme.title: JAG: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Mac defends and Turner prosecutes in the case of a special op marine who, during an Iraqi mission, may have deserted his team for his own survival. Harm takes on a CIA training assignment in a mach six craft that soon has him in danger.

programme.title: JAG: Close Quarters
programme.desc: Back at JAG, Harm is flooded with cases but still wants to help out an 80-year-old veteran accused of robbery. Meanwhile, Turner takes on an assignment in a sub whose crew has rescued possible defecting North Koreans.

programme.title: JAG: Posse Comitatus
programme.desc: Harm and Mac argue the case of a Marine pilot who used force to interfere with a local police matter that led to a man’s killing. Roberts is the investigating officer in the matter of a Navy doctor who is requesting conscientious objector status.

programme.title: JAG: The Boast
programme.desc: When an unwitting corporal boasts to a reporter that he killed an Iraqi prisoner of war, facts begin to emerge that could convict him despite his later claim that he was only lying toi mpress.

programme.title: JAG: Pulse Rate
programme.desc: Harm and Mac go aboard the USS Gillcrist to determine if a seaman’s fatal accident during a routine repair was the result of a co-worker’s dereliction of duty or worse.

programme.desc: A Kansas man pulls a gun on his brother, a woman reports her ex violating a court order to stay away from her, and officers have a heart-to-heart with a struggling addict.

programme.title: COPS

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Limbo
programme.desc: The Taelons lend some of their dwindling core energy to Joshua Doors for a pilot cold fusion project, but the energy is stolen, leaving the Taelons vulnerable. Jonathan Doors lives on as an AI in cyberspace.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Motherlode
programme.desc: Augur is caught and placed in a special prison where he is placed in a sensory deprivation chamber. An amoralist gets him out and wants Augur to help him steal the gold Zo'or has on the mothership. When Liam learns of what happened he tries to find Augur.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Take No Prisoners
programme.desc: The ANA negotiate amnesty for all resistance members, Liam tries to convince resistance member Halley Simmons to take the offer. Sandoval uses parasites to make volunteers do suicide missions against the resistance.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Second Wave
programme.desc: The Taelons decide to leave Earth when it appears that the Jiridians are invading. Meanwhile, a group of Resistance prisoners saved from the mother ship include several disguised Jiridians who are causing trouble for Liam and Renee.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Essence
programme.desc: Renee's brother has PTSD. In a desperate effort to help him, she agrees to let him undergo special treatment. The treatment removes his emotion. The project is overseen by Sandoval and the emotion they take is given to Da'an.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Phantom Companion
programme.desc: While on board the mothership, Renee sustains an injury and while being treated, she gets pulled into the walls and disappears.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Dream Stalker
programme.desc: Street asks Liam to help a friend who's arrested for the murder of a man he hated. Liam talks to him and he claims that he dreamed of killing him.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Lost Generation
programme.desc: A CVI malfunctions and kills a soon-to-be father. The investigation leads Liam and Renee to a fertility clinic. Renee finds out she is infertile and suspects that Taelon technology is affecting worldwide fertility.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Summit
programme.desc: Da'an leaves and doesn't being Liam along. Zo'or is frantic as to why Da'an left. Liam wants to help but Zo'or doesn't trust him because he doesn't have a CVI, so Liam agrees to be implanted.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Dark Matter
programme.desc: When the mother ship hits dark matter, the ship dos not begin to heal itself. Zo'or is left in an unconscious state and Sandoval takes control. He decides it is time to liberate the Earth from the Taelons.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Keys to the Kingdom
programme.desc: The relic left by Ma'el is stolen from the mother ship. Zo'or threatens to destroy a major city if it isn't returned. Liam believes the final chapters contain information on synthesizing core energy.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Street Chase
programme.desc: Sandoval is watching via nanobots inside Street as she tries to decipher Ma'el's riddle. She tries to figure out how to escape from Sandoval and the Taelons forcing her to solve the riddle. She flashes back to childhood fears.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Trapped by Time
programme.desc: Liam and Renee learn of a facility where time travelers from the future are being held. They try to learn from them what happens to the Taelons. Sandoval's wife is used as a pawn to gain important information from him.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Atonement
programme.desc: Sandoval goes to Renee to request a trial to testify to atrocities against humanity committed by the Taelons. A manhunt for Sandoval begins when he quits and leaves the mother ship. Liam has to protect him on his way to the grand jury.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Blood Ties
programme.desc: Strange assaults and several deaths may be related to a Doors/Taelon joint venture where Taelon core energy was used to heal people. It appears that the energy is being sucked back out of the patients.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Hearts and Minds
programme.desc: When Renee's boyfriend appears to her while he is imprisoned on the mother ship, Liam theorizes a special energy bond between the pair. Zo'or is upset by the human's betrayal and bans all humans from the mother ship.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Epiphany
programme.desc: The Taelons announce that they will all go into death stasis and wait on the mother ship for humans to discover how to create core energy and revive them. Zo'or and Da'an don't trust each other to be the last to submit to stasis.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Dark Horizons
programme.desc: Eight Taelons are killed when protectors' implants are re-calibrated with a new imperative to kill instead of protect Taelons. They fear the Jiridians have found a way to control the CVIs. Meanwhile, their core energy continues to deplete.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Point of No Return
programme.desc: When Street solves the 8th dimension of Ma'el's riddle, a beacon leads Liam to a chamber with a healing pool. However, there is only enough in the healing pool to help 6 Taelons. Zo'or will do anything to insure his own life.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Decision
programme.desc: Police captain William Boone is asked to join the security team of Companion Da'an of the Taelon, an alien race that came to earth three years ago.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Truth
programme.desc: Boone tries to find out who murdered his wife.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Hotline
programme.desc: After three women are found strangled, Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate whether or not there is a connection between the attacks and an erotic hotline. Also starring Al Waxman and Carl Lumbly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Internal Affairs
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are assigned by Internal Affairs to check out a security leak among the 14th Precinct's personnel, forcing the duo to reluctantly spy on their colleagues. Also starring Al Waxman and Carl Lumbly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Mr. Lonelyhearts
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are called in when an elderly man comes looking for his wife. But a simple missing persons case soon turns into a major bigamy and fraud case. All the while Cagney deals with a suitor.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Conduct Unbecoming
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) team together with another detective, Charles Stephens (guest star Christopher Allport), to investigate an illegal handgun operation. However, their investigation is impeded by Charles's suspension.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: I'll Be Home For Christmas
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are looking forward to an early release on Christmas Eve when a man dressed as Santa Claus (guest star Richard Masur), who has been arrested for charity fraud, escapes from his cell in the 14th precinct.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Recreational Use
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey team up with Sergeant Dory McKenna (guest star Barry Primus) in an investigation of a group of senior citizens terrorized by their landlord. Cagney's romance with Dory is complicated by his addiction to cocaine.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Hopes And Dreams
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate a series of burglaries that occurred while all of the victims were at funerals. They become especially interested in a young teenage victim, who is bound to a wheelchair.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Grandest Jewel Thief Of Them All
programme.desc: Lacey (Tyne Daly) becomes worried when Cagney (Sharon Gless) becomes obsessed with catching notorious jewel thief Albert Grand (guest star Ferdy Mayne), who despite committing several hotel safe robberies has never been convicted.
programme.sub-title: Grandest Jewel Thief Of Them All

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Affirmative Action
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) find that they have very mixed emotions when another female detective (guest star Talia Balsam) is assigned to the 14th precinct. Also staring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels and Carl Lumbly as Mark Petrie.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Open And Shut Case
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey's (Tyne Daly) faith in the legal system is tested when a solid homicide case crumbles and a friend and former rape victim is forced to relive her courtroom ordeal. Also staring Al Waxman and Carl Lumbly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Jane Doe #37
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) refuses to drop the investigation into a murdered Jane Doe, who also happens to be a homeless woman. Cagney is determined to discover her real identity before her burial. Also starring Tyne Daly, Al Waxman, and Carl Lumbly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Date Rape
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey are at odds over the investigation of a rape case. Cagney sides with the male investigators who feel the woman is at fault, while Lacey sides with the woman. Things become more complicated when the woman's past is used against her.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Burn-Out
programme.desc: When Lacey's vacation is temporarily postponed, she becomes overwhelmed with her responsibilities as a cop, wife, and mother. Meanwhile, Cagney goes undercover as a nun to investigate drugs that have gone missing from a hospital.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Chop Shop
programme.desc: Detective Victor Isbecki's cover is blown during an investigation of a dangerous car theft ring and he becomes a hostage. Cagney and Lacey must work to help save him while coming to terms with their own failures in the investigation.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Let Them Eat Pretzels
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey find what should be a simple hit-and-run accident becomes deeply complicated when the son of a diplomat becomes involved. The team must figure out how to arrest the son, while the father attempts to stop them.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: The Gang's All There
programme.desc: While out at a bar celebrating Petrie's promotion, the 14th precinct is robbed of their guns, shields, and possessions. The team then works furiously to find the perpetrators after they become the laughing stock of the entire NYPD.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Cry For Help
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey are assigned to investigate a wife-beating case and discover that the victim's husband is a cop and former classmate of Lacey's. Meanwhile the team also has to find a way to charge a con man after they are forced to let him go.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: The Informant
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey run into an issue with their drug investigation when it turns out that their teenage informant is a perpetrator of the crimes himself. They are then faced with the dilemma of releasing a one criminal in order to arrest another.

programme.title: Charmed

programme.title: Charmed

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes Bromas
programme.desc: Se celebra el día de las bromas en Palm Woods y da comienzo una guerra de bromas de chicos contra chicas.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Gurú
programme.desc: Gustavo contrata a un gurú espiritual para que lo ayude a controlar su ira, pero cuando convence para que delegue en él la dirección de Rocque Records, los chicos tendrán que hacer todo lo posible por recuperar el control sobre Big Time Rush.

programme.title: Big Time Rush
programme.desc: Los chicos están contentos de volver a Minnesota por Navidad, pero Gustavo no los dejará marchar hasta que no terminene de grabar un single navideño.

programme.title: Big Time Rush
programme.desc: Los chicos están contentos de volver a Minnesota por Navidad, pero Gustavo no los dejará marchar hasta que no terminene de grabar un single navideño.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes Compositores
programme.desc: Decididos a implicarse más en el proceso de grabación, los chicos deciden competir para ver quién escribe una canción nueva para BTR.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes Enamoramientos
programme.desc: Kendall y Jo ayudan a Carlos a encontrar una novia y Logan flirtea con una chica nueva mientras intenta aclarar qué siente por Camille. James quiere ayudar a Katie a acercarse a un chico que le gusta pero acabará portándose como un padre protector.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Grupo De Chicas
programme.desc: Gustavo funda un grupo pop solo de chicas, lo que desencadenará los celos de los chicos.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Gran fiesta en la playa
programme.desc: Los chicos tienen la oportunidad de pasar un día en la casa de la playa de Griffin e invitan a todos sus amigos de Palm Woods. Carlos y Logan buscan un tesoro escondido y James se enamora de una chica, de la que sospecha es una sirena.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Realidad
programme.desc: Griffin filma la vida de los chicos para un programa de telerealidad.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Mamá
programme.desc: La madre de James, apodada la 'la Estee Lauder del Medioeste' por su existosa línea de cosméticos, llega a Palm Woods para llevarse a James a casa y prepararlo para que el chico asuma el control de la compañía familiar.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Ruptura
programme.desc: Kendall y Jo deben asumir el futuro de su relación cuando la chica consigue un gran papel en una superproducción que se va a rodar en el extranjero durante tres años.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Proyecto Verde
programme.desc: Una competición de clase para convertir Palm Woods en un entorno más ecológico acaba en desastre.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Boda
programme.desc: El romance de cuento de hadas de James con una princesa extranjera acaba rápidamente en una misión de fuga cuando el chico, inadvertidamente, le propone matrimonio a la princesa. Sus amigos deberán liberarlo antes de que se celebre una boda real.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Rey Del Baile
programme.desc: Se acerca el baile anual del colegio de Palm Woods y Carlos, James, Logan y Kendall están decididos, cueste lo que cueste, a obtener el título de rey del baile.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Concurso
programme.desc: Una revista para adolescentes organiza el concurso 'Gana una cita con BTR' y las cuatro afortunadas ganadoras, cada una con sus propios problemas, serán una pesadilla para los muchachos.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Roquera
programme.desc: Lucy, una roquera muy guay de 18 años, se muda a Palm Woods e inmediatamente se lleva de calle a los chicos de BTR. Carlos y James se proponen cada uno salir con ella mientras Kendall se afana por demostrar que BTR también puede rocanrolear.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Huelga
programme.desc: BTR se niega a grabar su segundo álbum después de la dureza con la que Gustavo los ha tratado. La huelga se convierte en una batalla de voluntades entre el denonado grupo y su testarudo productor.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Sencillo
programme.desc: Mientras Gustavo sufre componiendo el siguiente éxito del grupo, los chicos intentan animar al desconsolado Kendall después de su ruptura con Jo.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes Superhéroes
programme.desc: Hawk ha vuelto y tiene un nuevo plan diabólico para hundir a Big Time Rush. Planea robar las nuevas pistas de BTR y apropiárselas como si fueran suyas.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Secreto
programme.desc: Hay secretos en Palm Woods. Kendall y Camille pasan mucho tiempo juntos, lo que levanta las sospechas de Logan. James revela que nunca le dijo a Carlos que Heather Fox, la chica del campamento que le gustaba a Carlos, también estaba por él.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Mudanza
programme.desc: Los chicos tienen una gran pelea y deciden separarse. James se retira a un apartamento lujoso, Logan se marcha a vivir a una casa de la playa, Carlos se construye una casa de cartón y Kendall deberá arreglar las cosas.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Entrevista
programme.desc: Big Time Rush acaba de publicar su segundo álbum y los chicos son entrevistados para un programa musical donde responderán preguntas y revelan su vida dentro y fuera de Big Time Rush.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Lío entre bastidores
programme.desc: Es la última parada en la gira mundial de BTR e iremos entre bambalinas para ver toda la locura que sucede detrás del escenario. Veremos cómo los chicos se preparan para el concierto y lidian con los problemas que surgen.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes retornos
programme.desc: Los chicos regresan de su gira mundial a Palm Woods siendo ya famosos, aunque lo que ellos quieren ahora es descansar y ligar. Griffin intenta sobornar a Carlos para que escoja su canción favorita para la próxima entrevista en la radio de los chicos.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El gran Bel Air
programme.desc: BTR son demasiado famosos para vivir en Palm Woods, de modo que Gustavo traslada al grupo a Bel Air. Sin embargo, las reglas que acompañan a una vida de lujo no van con los chicos y estos planean su gran escapada para volver a Palm Woods.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran cita doble
programme.desc: El amor está en el aire en Palm Woods. James ayuda a Carlos con su cita con una de las Jennifers, Kendall irá a cenar a casa de los padres de Lucy y Logan acepta una cita a ciegas para poder espiar a Camille con Jett.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes subproductos
programme.desc: Griffin pretende colocar una línea de productos de marca BTR en Selmart pero a los chicos no les gustan nada los productos y tomarán cartas en el asunto saboteando la reunión, con lo que conseguirán que se prohiba su música en la cadena Selmart.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran sorpresa
programme.desc: Kendall y Lucy están a punto de besarse por primera vez pero aparece Beau, el guapo ex de Lucy con la intención de reconquistarla. Griffin recluta a Logan y a Carlos para una operación de espionaje corporativo.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran decisión
programme.desc: Kendall está listo para pedirle salir a Lucy pero aparece Jo inesperadamente y Kendall tendrá que decidir entre las dos chicas. Mientras tanto, la amistad entre Carlos y James es puesta a prueba.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes canguros
programme.desc: Kendall y Logan deberán ocuparse del nuevo artista de Rocque Records, una leyenda del rock venida a menos, hasta su ingreso en el panteón de la fama del rocanrol esa noche. James y Carlos estarán haciendo de niñeras de Katie.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran acampada
programme.desc: Los chicos quieren ir de acampada pero Gustavo veta la idea porque es peligroso. A cambio, usan sus conexiones para acampar en un estudio de sonido pero la cosa se tuerce cuando los chicos empiezan a hacer el bruto.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El gran rescate
programme.desc: Kendall y Logan se presentan voluntarios en un refugio canino y acaban adoptando a 12 perros pero un inspector de sanidad muy ladino los vigila. El amor entre Carlos y Jennifer asquea a James y las otras Jennifers, quienes intentarán rescatarlos.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran fiebre del oro
programme.desc: Kendall le regala a Jo un collar de oro para demostrarle su compromiso pero Camille piensa que Logan se lo ha comprado a ella. Gustavo cuelga un nuevo disco de oro de BTR y Carlos y James se preguntan qué pasaría si lo pusieran en el tocadiscos.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes meteduras de pata
programme.desc: Los chicos destruyen por accidente la cinta del nuevo episodio de Big Time Rush que debían entregar a la cadena. Para sustituir el episodio, los chicos deciden hacer un programa de tomas falsas con Stephen Glickman y Clara Bravo como presentadores.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran invasión
programme.desc: ¡BTR tiene que impedir la invasión de los grupos británicos de chicos! Ya que Gustavo está demasiado disperso, los chicos contratan a un agente musical famoso, pero al no ponerse de acuerdo, el grupo se disuelve y la brecha se acentúa en el grupo.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El gran escándalo
programme.desc: Lucy publica su album de venganza contra Kendall con gran éxito. James, desesperado por llamar la atención, difunde el rumor de que va a grabar un duo con Cher Lloyd y Carlos recibe mala prensa al golpear, supuestamente, a una anciana.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes mentiras
programme.desc: Kendall debe impedir que Jo descubra que Lucy ha vuelto a Palm Woods. La mentirijilla de Logan sobre estar enfermo acaba convirtiéndose en una emergencia médica y Carlos y James alegan que se ha producido un robo en Rocque Records.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran bonificación

programme.title: 10 parejas 10: Episodio 104
programme.desc: Un desafío invita a las exparejas de los chicos a tirar basura y pasar la noche en la casa. Brittany tiene problemas para captar el mensaje obvio de que Adam no está interesado. Coleysia y Ashleigh encienden sus propios romances.

programme.title: 10 parejas 10
programme.desc: Las tensiones entre John y Simone llegan a un punto de ebullición. El interés de Kayla en Wes se renovó a pesar de que todavía se aferra a Ryan. Los espíritus se levantan cuando un desafío en cascada envía a dos parejas a la cabina de la verdad.

programme.title: 10 parejas 10: Episodio 106
programme.desc: La casa conspira para descubrir la próxima pareja perfecta. Kayla es acusada de engañar a Ryan y Wes, mientras que Simone intenta separar a Chris T y Shanley para siempre. Y un viaje a la cabina de la verdad envía la casa al caos.

programme.title: 10 parejas 10: Episodio 107
programme.desc: La casa se tambalea después de que Paige y Chris T sean confirmados como una pareja perfecta y enviados a la Suite de Luna de Miel. Shanley está devastada por haber sido separada de Chris T. Y Kayla lo pierde cuando Ryan va a consolar a Jessica.

programme.title: Acapulco Shore: Llegó la que no aguanta
programme.desc: Una nueva integrante llega a la casa. La boss anuncia que tienen que trabajar para ser parte del carnaval. El team tendo insiste en que Jey se lleve a la cama a Nacha y un bar es el sitio de encuentros y desencuentros de la familia.

programme.title: Acapulco Shore: La maldición del Pitoflan
programme.desc: Tadeo recibe una sorpresa y los shore se conmueven con su reacción. La celebración del cumpleaños de Xavier comienza. Chile y Jey tienen problemas de erección y Jawy reta a Chile a un duelo de boxeo.

programme.title: Acapulco Shore: El perro de la discordia
programme.desc: La espera termina y Jey por fin logra cumplirle a Nacha. Celia manda a un grupo a trabajar al acuario. La celebración de Xavier continua y las comadres se escapan del antro lo que hace que Mane y Jawy terminen peleando.

programme.title: Acapulco Shore: A pedir perdón
programme.desc: Jawy y Mane continúan. Xavi decide invitar a Pepe para que se quede en la casa. Los shore comienzan a dudar de Fernanda. Karime busca al notario para que valide su virginidad y Mane y Fernanda terminan en un fuerte enfrentamiento.

programme.title: Acapulco Shore: El examen
programme.desc: Mane y Fernanda se van a los golpes. El conclave decide hacerle un examen a Fernanda para evitar su expulsión. Un partido de fútbol entre los Shore y los Big hippo decidirá el futuro de la casa y Pepe recibe una propuesta de amor eterno.
